# Guidify

> Guidify empowers entrepreneurs worldwide with digital solutions. Founded in 2024 in Belgium, Guidify builds independent digital products.

## Products
- [Investedia](https://investedia.com): financial news, markets and investment intelligence, with education for people learning to invest. Live.
- [Droplates](https://droplates.com): website templates and creation tools to launch a site faster. In development.
